notes.title: Heads Up
notes.content: Hi everyone, we are back from vacation and ready to roll. Things are getting good on our side. We are putting meat on the bone little by little. They say "do the prog and deal with bugs later". We prefect to put only codes that we know will work. So we take times to do things right. We just hope you will like it.

notes.title: Mazania major upgrade ahead
notes.content:
Since the early release of our game, we listen to comments and find a proper scenario that will please a lot of gamer. Multiplayer, range weapons, monsters, aliens and robots to fight, item management and crafting are on the planning. A lot of people express us their desire to explore something else than a maze so that would probably be on the table too. 

One thing is sure : Mazania will not be as lean and flat as it once was before. 

So keep an eye on it, since drastic changes are already in progress.

notes.title: Game breaker resolved
notes.content:
It came to our attention that there were few game breaker that make the game unplayable for some player. We find solutions quickly. Here is what we did :

1- When solving a maze, it didn't unlocked the next level : We decided to unlock every level for everyone. It wont record your advancement anymore since it's no longer necessary.
2- Random high slope of the ground that prevent moving forward into the maze or fall through the ceiling floor : we simply made the slope curve smaller, so there are no borders that are too high from one another anymore and it's more difficult to run under the floor. However, it's a little esthetic. We will raise the slope curve again when the climbing ability will be fully operational.
3- Extreme lagging at bigger maze : we decided to disable camera effects since they play a big part in that lagging process. We will eventually make a directional shape activator and work on a lod process and reactivate camera effects. Managing option by the user is going to be our next development.

Hoping this will help some of you be able to appreciate our game a little more.

notes.title: Early release released earlier
notes.content:
Since we didn't plan on doing major changes to the actual version until the release day, we decided to release it today. Why waiting? You can now enjoy the fun of running through giant mazes and test you geometrical memory skills. Try not to loose you mind and have fun!

Cheers everyone.

notes.title: Discord server for Mazania
notes.content:
Discord server for Mazania is now open and fresh! Here is the link : https://discord.gg/zmsQNM3

Any needs you have towards the game can be found there : technical support, discussions, suggestions or whats next on Mazania, you can found it there. We will try to keep discussions as fast and open as possible. If you have something that we can find interesting for the game, we want to hear it! Remember, this game is the beginning of something big. So any suggestion will be appreciated.

See you there!

notes.title: Early release soon
notes.content: Hi everyone! Since Mazania will soon be in early release, we will take this opportunity to share our excitement with all of you. We have been working on the game for some time to make it smooth, fast and as functionnal as possible, some tweeking are done every day so when it's out, make sure updates are properly done every times. As we speak, bugs and glitches are gone a long time ago, so we hope you can enjoy it as we do. Until then, cheers.
